description:
The iVISION dataset is a publicly released dataset collected through drone missions conducted over a University of Waterloo residential building construction site. It is intended to support academic research in computer vision, computer graphics, and robotics. The data were captured using a DJI Matrice 350 drone equipped with a Zenmuse L2 sensor and an RTK base station. We release all raw data collected during these missions, including high-resolution RGB images, raw LiDAR data, and video recordings.

Due to size limitations, we split the dataset by scenes. The split is defined below:
Sep 2024 - Dec 2024: [https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/danielmao2019/ivision-fall2024](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/danielmao2019/ivision-fall2024)
Jan 2025 - Apr 2025: [https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/danielmao2019/ivision-winter2025](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/danielmao2019/ivision-winter2025)
title: iVISION - Fall2024
